opening.argument: The $163 million figure is presented as a conditional calculation, not a demonstrated payout. The narration asks what a $100 Terra Luna Classic investment would be worth at the token’s all-time high, then calculates the result if that price is reached again. The displayed current and highest prices make the comparison visible. The title does tell viewers to buy $100 of the token, but the calculation itself does not guarantee a return or establish that the old price is realistically attainable, and it gives no instruction to send money to the presenter.

citations.quote: if you invested 100 into terraluna right now how much would it be at the all-time high
multiply 1.63 million by your 100 investment and we get 163 million dollars once it reaches the all-time price high again
